approval.status: User explicitly approved revised three-icon concept before production.
approval.revisionReason: User requested the first soul reflect the samurai boss rather than the original wooden totem.

preservation: Each selected generated PNG was copied byte-for-byte. Original RGBA pixels and generated alpha are preserved; no programmatic pixel editing, matte removal, resizing or alpha modification. Inventory crops are metadata only.
coordinateConvention: Bounds are [left, top, right, bottom], right/bottom exclusive. Recommended crops include 12 source pixels beyond alpha>=8 silhouette.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: FINAL PRODUCTION high-resolution standalone inventory collectible sprite for the painted Japanese fantasy game Kiba. Generate ONE square image, 1024x1024 or larger square, with genuinely transparent RGBA background.
Input image: boss-souls-concept-v2.png is the USER-APPROVED DESIGN REFERENCE. Extract/re-create ONLY THE LEFT ICON as a standalone finished asset. Middle and right icons MUST NOT appear.
Subject: the samurai boss's spectral soul, matching the approved left icon: empty battered black and deep-crimson lacquered kabuto helmet with its very tall weathered gold V-shaped crest; dark empty menpo mask beneath; compact scarred black/crimson lamellar neck/shoulder plates with gold edging and scarlet braided armor cords; one broken silver katana diagonally behind the helmet, dark grip with scarlet diamonds at upper left and jagged broken blade extending lower right. Jade-teal Kiba soul-flame wraps around and emerges from inside the helmet with bright solid luminous painted ribbons and dark-edged internal detail. Empty glowing teal eye slits, no living head or body. Preserve the approved recognizable overall composition, helmet, colors, motifs and elegant flame silhouette.
Style: richly detailed hand-painted Japanese dark fantasy treasure art with crisp material edges, textured aged gold, crimson lacquer, black metal, chipped steel and jewel-like luminous teal soul energy; matching supplied concept. Fully opaque richly colored material cores and firm edges that remain readable at 112px inventory size; controlled soft alpha only at flame tips, no faded wash.
Framing: isolated entire single floating object centered in a square, fit ALL horns, sword tip, grip, armor, cords and flames fully inside canvas with at least 8% clear transparent padding around the complete silhouette. No cropping. No background, backdrop, dark matte, ground, pedestal, stand, separate decoration, UI, text or watermark. Do not include any wood, bark, moss, roots, forest totem, human face, duplicate helmet or full character. TRUE transparency outside the single object, and within natural gaps between blade/helmet/flame. Keep the existing approved design; this is refinement for production, no redesign.

framingRepair.reason: Initial flame fringe approached the top and bottom canvas edge. A built-in image edit fit the entire approved design within wider transparent margins.
framingRepair.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Production sprite framing repair only. Input is the approved Kiba samurai boss soul production art with true alpha. Preserve the exact single object's design, painting, armor, gold kabuto, teal soul flames, scarlet cord and broken katana, colors and all internal details unchanged. The object is currently too tall and nearly touches top and bottom. Zoom out / make the WHOLE existing object uniformly SMALLER so ALL visible flame tips, gold crest, sword tip and cords fit inside a centered bounding rectangle occupying at most 78% of the canvas height and width. Provide at least 10% completely empty genuinely transparent RGBA margin at TOP, BOTTOM, LEFT and RIGHT beyond all particles and glow. Same square canvas. Show the FULL intact upper flame curl and lower curl with no clipped or hidden ends. Do not redesign, rotate, add extra particles, add background, dark matte or text. Transparent outside and in existing gaps. Keep the opaque luminous material cores; this is only fitting the complete silhouette safely into the canvas.

checks: Inspected all three selected PNGs against the approved v2 concept.
Confirmed native RGBA and alpha range 0..255 with Pillow.
Measured alpha>=8, >=32 and >=128 bounds without changing source pixels.
